versions.content: The RTE is required to treat AUTOSAR signals transmitted using sender-receiver communication atomically [SRS_Rte_00073]. To achieve this • either the signal group mechanisms provided by COM shall be utilized. See [SWS_Rte_02557] for the mapping. • or the Data Transformation approach (see section 4.10) shall be utilized.
